name: Representative merchant freighter
axes: right-handed: X longitudinal/bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse
dimensionBasis: Illustrative generic cargo-steamer dimensions; independent of convoy GRT and not a named historical class.

reference.configuration: Original generic cargo steamer with central bridge and funnel, four cargo hatches, two derrick masts and no modeled armament.
reference.note: Original project geometry for aggregate merchant hulls. Visual dimensions, equipment and colors are representative, not individual ship specifications or historical reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
